styles.name: Textured Abstract Paintings
styles.base_description: Thick impasto-style oil painting aesthetic with bold palette knife marks and three-dimensional texture visible in the image. Covers abstract expressionism, gestural abstraction, and colour field painting. Appeals to buyers decorating modern, minimalist, and boho interiors. Neutral colour palettes outsell vibrant ones 3:1 in this category.
styles.technique_hint: impasto oil painting, palette knife texture, thick paint application, gestural abstraction

styles.name: Impressionist & Modern Style Paintings
styles.base_description: Loose painterly brushwork spanning the Impressionist tradition and modern painterly styles — from atmospheric Monet-inspired landscapes to bold Fauvist colour and post-impressionist form. Visible paint texture, expressive brushmarks, and emotional warmth. Consistently one of the top-selling wall art categories globally.
styles.technique_hint: loose impressionist brushwork, expressive modern painterly style, visible brushmarks, atmospheric perspective

styles.name: Nature & Landscape Paintings
styles.base_description: A broad category spanning detailed botanical studies and sweeping landscape paintings. Includes watercolour botanicals on cream backgrounds, dramatic mountain and forest panoramas, and serene countryside scenes. Strong sellers for nurseries, kitchens, living rooms, and as gifts. Sets of 3 or 4 matching prints are particularly high-converting.
styles.technique_hint: watercolour and gouache botanical study, or oil landscape with atmospheric depth, natural light

styles.name: Floral Pop Paintings
styles.base_description: Bold, oversized floral paintings with graphic intensity and saturated colour — the breakout trend of 2026 on Etsy. Maximalist composition, strong contrast, contemporary art fair aesthetic. These photograph exceptionally well for Etsy listings and drive impulse purchases from buyers scrolling on mobile.

styles.name: Contemporary Portraiture & Figurative Work
styles.base_description: Modern figurative art and portraiture with expressive brushwork. No specific real people — abstract or silhouette-based figures only. Covers contemporary portraiture, figurative expressionism, and gestural figure studies. Strong sellers in the higher price bracket, popular with buyers furnishing living rooms, home offices and studios.
styles.technique_hint: expressive figurative brushwork, abstract silhouette, gestural portrait marks, contemporary figurative oil
